title: Terry Lovelace's phone health data shows six stories climbed in a one-story house

tellings.quote: lel's cell phone Health Data that shows

plain: A man named Terry Lovelace, who lives in a one-story house, is said to have phone health data showing he climbed six stories one day. John Blitch, a scientist with the Pentagon's advanced research agency who says he was himself abducted by an alien, mentions it as something Lovelace showed. The point is that Lovelace's body went somewhere higher than his house allows, as might happen if he were taken up into a craft.
